Who we are

One group, four disciplines, one standard of work.

GB GROUP exists to make complex work simpler for businesses, landowners, students and families across eastern India. Instead of coordinating separate brokers and agencies, clients come to one team that stays accountable from first conversation to final delivery.

Our strength is local: we know the industrial corridors, the admission landscape, the land records and the media routes of Jharkhand and West Bengal. That knowledge is backed by documentation, clear communication and direct access to our leadership.
